text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate across Dedicated pools - severity: P2 - paged: #eng-oncall @jessica now

jessica (oncall): seeing it. what scopes? hosted or Dedicated customer pools?

sam (infra): Dedicated. spike concentrated on ded-nyc-1-acme and ded-nyc-1-shared. 5xx went from ~0.5% to 18% in 3m. error payloads look like OOM/eviction-related KV cache misses. CPU and GPU util are pegged on a subset of nodes.

ryan (runtime): autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. thresholds at 70% GPU mem usage + 300ms queue time. incoming QPS jump looks sudden from one large org.

jessica (oncall): impact: ACME org traffic ~40% of requests to those pools. customers seeing errors + qps throttles? cs-maria any reports?

cs-maria: ACME reported degraded but not total outage. They see many 502/503s and retries. They've paused a few jobs but still high traffic. They said it's coming from an internal batch job gone runaway.

sam (infra): immediate mitigation options:
- toggle burst capacity on for the affected Dedicated pool(s)
- temporarily increase min replicas for ded-nyc-1-acme
- apply org-level rate limit (soft) to ACME to smooth retries
- route their traffic to a fallback compatible model with lower memory (quantized)

jessica (oncall): i'll toggle burst and bump pool. performing command now:
```
# enable burst and bump to +4 GPUs (temporary)
rbctl pools set-burst ded-nyc-1-acme --enable --burst-size 4 --reason "oncall: transient surge"
rbctl pools set-min-replicas ded-nyc-1-acme --min 6
```

deploy-bot: action recorded: pool=ded-nyc-1-acme burst=enabled(+4) min_replicas=6 by jessica. change-id=chg-20260315-9843

jessica (oncall): CLI returned OK, API shows scaling jobs started. watching metrics.

sam (infra): i'm flipping an org soft rate limit to absorb retry storm. setting ACME: 30 rps / 60s burst window. command:
```
# caution: soft rate limit, returns 429 to new requests after threshold
rbctl orgs update-quota acme-org --rate 30 --window 60 --mode soft --reason "mitigate runaway batch"
```

jessica (oncall): applied. added rule to routing so that if errors persist we divert to fallback model m-gpt-8q-compat. config:
```
runtime-routing set-policy acme-org --primary ded-nyc-1-acme:m-gpt-16 --fallback ded-nyc-1-acme:m-gpt-8q-compat --fallback-threshold 10%_5xx
```

ryan (runtime): note: fallback model reduces quality a bit but cut memory by ~60%. also enabling KV-prefix caching for acme org to reduce repeated prefix recompute.

sam (infra): after toggles, 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 4% within 4m, overall latency ~+200ms while new GPUs attach. good sign.

cs-maria: ACME confirms errors reduced, they're re-running the job slowly on their end. they asked for ETA on removing limits.

jessica (oncall): we'll keep burst enabled for 30m and monitor. if stable for 20m and ACME backs off, revert to normal. logging actions and creating incident record. tagging for follow-up: autoscaler tuning, burst budget review, per-org circuit breaker docs.

ryan (runtime): action items captured:
- lower autoscaler cool-down to 40s for dedicated pools serving bursty customers
- add a pre-warm policy to allow faster GPU allocation when queue time spikes
- add a canary test for burst toggle to avoid config drift

jessica (oncall): also note: we need a short customer-impact blurb for ops status page. sampling numbers: ~2.4k requests failed during peak window (5m), majority ACME.

incident-bot: incident record created: INC-20260315-67 severity=P2 owner=jessica status=mitigated

sam (infra): leaving one more precaution: set a temporary quota reduction for non-critical shared pools to preserve headroom:
```
rbctl pools set-shared-quota --region nyc --limit 70% --reason "transient surge reserve"
```

jessica (oncall): acknowledged. i'll handoff at 02:00Z to night oncall. handoff note:
- state: mitigated, burst=enabled, min_replicas=6, ACME org soft rate=30rps, fallback routing enabled
- next steps: monitor 5xx, if it climbs >8% re-escalate to P1 and consider disabling scheduled jobs for ACME in coordination with CS
- contact: cs-maria for customer comms, ryan for runtime tweaks

cs-maria: i told ACME SRE to keep us updated. they aim to pause their job in 12m. they thanked us. :thumbsup:

jessica (oncall): wrapping. will file post-incident tasks and assign. final status will remain open until burst toggles are reverted and autoscaler changes deployed.

deploy-bot: handoff checkpoint saved to oncall-log by jessica at 1768055150

jessica (oncall): night oncall, please watch for a gradual teardown step at +30m. if load remains >50% baseline, leave burst on and notify infra. otherwise revert with:
```
rbctl pools set-burst ded-nyc-1-acme --disable --reason "surge subsided"
rbctl pools set-min-replicas ded-nyc-1-acme --min 2
rbctl orgs update-quota acme-org --rate 200 --window 60 --mode normal
```

jessica (oncall): thanks all, closing active paging for now. :white_check_mark:
